source_text: In April 2021, Coptic Pope Tawadros II of the [Coptic Orthodox Church](/page/Coptic_Orthodox Church) issued a formal declaration rejecting female genital mutilation (FGM), affirming a zero-tolerance policy toward the practice as part of broader commitments to combat violence against women. [66]
